title: Patch: Stay in the Folder
story: File names from users can climb out with ../ . Keep every read inside the uploads folder.
goal: Write safe_path(base, name) returning the full path, or raising ValueError if it leaves base.
hints: os.path.realpath or normpath removes the .. parts so you can compare.
After normalising, check the result still starts with base + a slash.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
